title: Acyclicity of the tabulation prefix
statement: Let $n,W\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $z$ be a finite list of Boolean values. The list consisting of gates for the two Boolean constants, one constant gate for each entry of $z$, and $W$ additional false-constant gates is acyclic relative to the $n$ input vertices.
